description: A volunteer archer in the supplied pixel art style. A wide conical straw hat, a tan tunic with a dark vest, a red sash, a quiver of arrows on his back, dark boots. He holds a brown recurve bow in the left hand
rear_detail: Seen from behind: the wide straw hat, the tan tunic, the quiver of arrows across the back, the bow at his left side.
guard_action: the left hand raises the bow in front of the body, the right hand comes to the string, the feet take an archer stance

actions.idle: Archer ready stance, bow held in front in the left hand, breathing
actions.move: Seamless combat run in place carrying the bow in the left hand, no shooting. The last frame leads into the first, no pause
actions.a1: One arrow shot. Frames 1-6 the bow is raised level and the right hand draws the string back to full draw; frame 9 release; frames 10-11 the bow arm stays out. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The bow stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.b2: Two quick shots. Frames 1-5 a fast draw; frame 6 release; frames 7-9 a second fast draw; frame 10 release; frame 11 follow through. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The bow stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.a3: Low shot. Frames 1-6 he bends the knees deeply and draws the bow on a low flat line; frame 9 release; frames 10-11 hold low. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The bow stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.s2: Focused shot. Frames 1-7 he settles, draws steadily and holds the aim; frame 9 one release; frames 10-12 hold. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The bow stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.

notes: 2026-11-19 make_configs.py. 평타 a1 → b2 → a3, 전법 s2. 무기 좌표는 원화에서 눈으로 잰 값(±2px), 가려진 끝은 추정.
